text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Shut down... for real...? Wait, fr...
I seriously got shot down again...?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ugh... that looked like a fatal blow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Scattered by the wind.
These dark clouds won't clear away easily——

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ——BUT NEVA GIVUP!

text_block_list.name: All 3
text_block_list.text: ——Eh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should've popped giant party poppers?
Ugh, ran outta time～～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ain't no way I'm stopping, gotta go after My Princess again——

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up! Stop right there, Helios!
Giant party poppers are way too loud!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eeeh～? Pwetty pwease ♡

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's not the point...!
Besides, isn't your approach totally missed the mark?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you really want to escort Ruby-san,
you need to consider her feelings more carefully!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's the most crucial thing when choosing a dance partner.
...It was the exact same for me, too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
——!
You too, Bamboocchis...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Me too... I had to face her with everything I had.
On that day, when I danced with my greatest rival...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai and I clashed with our very souls...!
I wanted our fiery rivalry to burn even hotter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Facing each other head-on and dancing together... I believe we achieved that.
We truly connected as destined rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That red-hot dance is an irreplaceable treasure to me...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone holds something precious in their heart!
By sharing that with your partner, an unbreakable bond is forged!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ———Bamboocchis.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ——I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Eeehーー!
Were you even listening to me?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, that's way too galaxy brain for me!
But fr fr, I'm totally dead serious too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I legit wanna dance with Ruby! She's my absolute number one fave!
I just wanna vibe and party with her!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that what dancing is all about?
You had mega fun dancing with Ogurin too, right, Bamcham?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... it really was incredible fun. With Oguri-senpai,
I gave it my all, took the lead, and we danced our blazing hearts out...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It was so hot... and so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right?! That's the exact vibe I want with My Princess too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So I'm not giving up! I'll shoot my shot as many times as it takes!
And party super hard with My Princess!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna drop the sickest performance ever!
And we're snatching that Best Daaaaaate crownーーー!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Having fun together... so that's the passion in your heart...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ——UOOOOOOOOH! MY BLOOD IS BOILING!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Having fun together, dancing your heart out...!
Those are truly passionate feelings!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios! In that case, I will back you all the way! Youth means
coming together to make burning passion a reality!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
——Fufu, indeed. I, too, understand that yearning...
...The desire to dance alongside someone special.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So let us bring that to pass together.
———Right, Miracle-san?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. I believe Helios-san and Ruby-san could surely win Best Date together.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Helios-san's boundless energy always brightens everyone's mood.
I'm certain it will reach Ruby-san's heart just the same.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ～～～～! Love you guys sm!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aight, strat meeting time!
Big thanks, fam!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, how do you plan to make it enjoyable for Ruby-san?
We must respect her noble standards as well...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Wouldn't Helios-san's spirit of pure fun
help them capture the hearts and votes for Best Date?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: We merely need a way to prove that truth to Ruby-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You're right! Rather than just talking about
Helios's hype, it's better to show her proof they can win!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bet! Let's do this!
Time to show My Ladyーー!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, how tho?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...A performance shines brightest when you're truly having fun, right?
We should demonstrate that having fun together leads straight to victory!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
——Oh? Fr fr?!
So I just gotta flex how mega fun it's gonna be?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then... Bamboo! Be my Droite producer!
We're gonna cook up the hypest Droite ever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, we do a dry run rehearsal, yeah? Then invite My Princess!
We'll show off the sickest moves on the most lit stage imaginable!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I see! A stage where everyone has a blast,
proving that joy creates the brilliant ultimate shine!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! That's what I gotta show her!
If we vibe together, Best Date is totally in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ——I'm gonna be the ultimate escort for the Best Date!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mm... that spirit is scorching hot! All right, let's do this together!
A Droite where everyone rejoices in peak fun!

Yeah☆
LET'S GOOOO!
